mergedParams.userDescription: Bold, condensed, industrial blocky text with metallic textures. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

prompts.prompt: Create a bold industrial typography preset with a 'metal stamping' animation effect. Each word should slam into place like a heavy metal press stamping steel, with a brief screen shake on impact. The text appears in ultra-condensed, blocky letterforms with a metallic gradient texture (silver to gunmetal). Apply a subtle metallic sheen animation that travels across the text surface. Words should have staggered timing - each word drops from above with increasing force, creating a rhythmic industrial beat. Add a brief 'spark' effect at the impact point using a white flash that quickly fades. The background should have subtle scan lines or grid patterns reminiscent of industrial blueprints.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900' containing individual TextAtom components per word. Use caption data for word-level timing with 0.15s stagger between words. Text styling: 'font-black uppercase tracking-tighter' with custom fontSize based on impact metadata (high impact = larger). Apply metallic gradient via style prop: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #C0C0C0, #434343), backgroundClip: 'text'. Effects array: 1) translateY animation from -100 to 0 with spring easing, 2) scale from 1.2 to 1.0 on impact, 3) opacity fade-in. Add shake effect using internal 'shake-impact' preset at word appearance. Performance: use transform and opacity only, add will-change: transform to container. Timing: each word duration = 0.8s with 0.3s active animation, relative to parent start.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'hydraulic press' typography effect where text gets compressed and released in a mechanical, industrial motion. Letters start extremely tall and thin, then get pressed down into their final bold, condensed form like metal being forged. Include mechanical sound visualization - subtle vibration lines around the text during compression. The texture should be brushed metal with visible striations. Add steam/smoke effects that puff out from the sides as text compresses, using semi-transparent white overlays. Each line of text operates like a separate press cycle, creating a factory assembly line aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-zinc-800'. Each line as separate BaseLayout with TextAtom children. Initial state: scaleY(3) scaleX(0.3), animate to scaleY(1) scaleX(1) with custom cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Add ::before and ::after pseudo-elements via containerProps.style for steam effects using opacity and translateX animations. Texture via CSS: background-image with repeating linear gradient for brushed metal effect. Vibration: rapid translateX oscillation (-2px to 2px) during compression phase. Use repeatChildrenProps for consistent timing across words. Duration: 1.2s per line, 0.4s compression, 0.8s hold. Add blur(0) to blur(2px) to blur(0) for steam elements. Font: 'font-black text-6xl md:text-8xl' with letter-spacing: -0.08em.

prompts.prompt: Implement a 'laser engraving' text reveal where industrial blocky letters are carved into view by a glowing laser beam. The beam traces each letter's outline first, then fills with molten metal texture that cools to a brushed steel finish. Include sparks flying off during the engraving process and a subtle heat distortion effect around active areas. Text should have deep shadows and embossed appearance once complete. Add a subtle pulsing glow to keywords that persists after engraving, emphasizing important terms.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative bg-black overflow-hidden' with TextAtom per word. Use SVG clip-path animation for laser trace effect, animating stroke-dashoffset. Initial text opacity: 0, reveal with clip-path: inset() animation from 100% to 0%. Laser beam: absolutely positioned div with 'bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-cyan-400 to-transparent' moving across text bounds. Sparks: multiple small divs with 'bg-orange-400 rounded-full' using transform animations for particle physics. Heat distortion via CSS filter: blur() and brightness() keyframes. Final text: 'font-bold text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-300 to-gray-600' with text-shadow for depth. Keyword glow: identify via caption metadata, add animation-iteration-count: infinite for pulse effect. Timing: 2s per word with overlap, beam speed matches reveal rate.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'riveted metal plate' typography system where each word appears as a separate metal panel being bolted into place. Text sits on industrial metal plates with visible rivets in corners, slight rust texturing, and oil stain effects. Panels slide in from different directions with mechanical precision, locking into place with a satisfying clunk animation (slight bounce-back). Add subtle shadows between plates for depth. Include warning stripe borders on high-impact words. Background should feature a dark industrial warehouse aesthetic with distant machinery silhouettes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout grid 'grid auto-rows-auto gap-2 p-4'. Each word in separate BaseLayout with 'relative bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-600 to-gray-800 rounded-sm shadow-2xl' containerProps. Rivets: ::before/::after absolute positioned circles 'w-2 h-2 bg-gray-400 rounded-full shadow-inner'. Text: 'font-black uppercase text-white px-4 py-2'. Slide animations: alternate translateX(-100vw) and translateX(100vw) based on word index, ease-out timing. Bounce: scale(1) to scale(0.95) to scale(1.02) to scale(1) on arrival. Warning stripes via border-image or repeating-linear-gradient for impact > 0.7 words. Rust texture: CSS filter: sepia(0.3) saturate(1.2) on container. Oil stains: radial-gradient overlays with low opacity. Performance: transform-only animations, use transform3d for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'pneumatic hammer' text effect simulating industrial machinery repeatedly striking metal to form letters. Each character gets hammered into visibility with multiple rapid strikes, creating a staccato rhythm. The metal surface shows impact deformation - slight warping and stress marks around letters. Include flying metal shavings during impacts and a heat glow that fades as metal cools. Text should have a forged, hand-hammered quality with slight irregularities in alignment, giving it an authentic industrial workshop feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Character-level animation using TextAtom with split letters. BaseLayout 'flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-center'. Each letter animated with rapid scale pulses: [1, 0.8, 1.1, 0.9, 1.05, 1] over 0.3s. Opacity steps: [0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8, 0.9, 1] synchronized with scale. Metal shavings: absolute positioned spans with 'bg-orange-300' using transform: rotate() and translate() for projectile motion. Heat glow: text-shadow animation from '0 0 20px orange' to '0 0 0px transparent' over 2s. Deformation: slight random rotate (±2deg) and translateY (±2px) per character. Font: 'font-black' with custom letter-spacing: -0.02em. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth multi-strike sequences. Timing: 0.05s between strikes, 3-5 strikes per letter, 0.1s delay between letters.

prompts.prompt: Build an 'industrial LED display' preset where text appears as if displayed on a massive factory scoreboard with individual LED segments. Letters flicker to life with electrical interference, showing brief static and power surges. Include a subtle scan line effect moving vertically through the display. Text should have that characteristic LED dot matrix appearance with visible pixel gaps. Add occasional glitch effects where letters briefly scramble or shift color channels. Background should suggest a control room environment with ambient industrial lighting.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative bg-gray-950 overflow-hidden'. Text with custom font-family: monospace and 'font-black uppercase'. LED effect via CSS: background-image with repeating radial-gradient for dot pattern, mix-blend-mode: screen. Letter spacing: 0.1em for LED panel gaps. Flicker: rapid opacity changes [1, 0.3, 1, 0.5, 1] over 0.2s on mount. Scan line: absolute positioned div 'h-1 w-full bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-green-400/20 to-transparent' with translateY animation. Glitch effect: CSS animation alternating text-shadow RGB channel splits and transform: skewX(). Static: overlay div with noise texture, opacity pulses. Power surge: brightness filter animation 100% to 150% to 100%. Use caption data timing for sequential letter activation. Add 'will-change: opacity, filter' for performance.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'molten metal pour' typography effect where text appears to be formed by pouring liquid metal into letter-shaped molds. The metal flows from top to bottom, filling each letter progressively with glowing orange-to-silver gradient as it cools. Include bubbling and splatter effects at the pour points. Once filled, letters solidify with a crystallization effect spreading across the surface. Add industrial ambient elements like steam wisps and forge sparks in the background.
prompts.technicalSpecs: SVG-based approach with TextAtom inside masked containers. Use clip-path or SVG mask for progressive fill effect: polygon animating from top vertices to bottom. Fill gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-b from-orange-500 via-yellow-400 to-gray-400' with animation-delay for cooling effect. Bubbling: small circular divs with 'bg-orange-400/80 rounded-full' using scale and translateY animations at pour point. Pour stream: thin rectangular div 'w-1 bg-gradient-to-b from-orange-400 to-transparent' with height animation. Crystallization: overlay texture with opacity fade-in and subtle hue-rotate animation. Steam: multiple divs with blur filter and opacity animation, 'bg-white/20'. Performance: use transform and opacity only, batch DOM updates. Timing: 1.5s pour per word, 0.5s solidification, staggered by 0.3s between words.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'industrial printer' effect mimicking heavy-duty label makers or CNC engravers. Text appears character by character with mechanical precision, accompanied by a moving print head animation. Each character stamps with a slight screen shake and dust particle effect. Include authentic details like alignment guides, measurement marks, and registration crosses around the text area. The finished text should have a debossed appearance with deep shadows and slight texture variations suggesting real industrial printing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative border-2 border-gray-600 bg-gray-800'. Print head: absolute positioned div 'w-4 h-8 bg-gray-400' with translateX animation synchronized with character reveals. Characters revealed via width animation from 0 to auto with overflow: hidden on container. Shake: parent container translateY ±2px for 0.1s on each character print. Dust particles: spans with 'bg-gray-300/50 rounded-full w-1 h-1' using physics-based animation (gravity simulation). Alignment guides: CSS pseudo-elements with dashed borders. Text styling: 'font-black uppercase' with text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8) for debossed look. Letter-by-letter timing from caption data with 0.08s per character. Add subtle letter-spacing variation (±0.01em) for authentic imperfection.

prompts.prompt: Implement a 'welding spark' typography where letters are welded into existence with bright arc flashes and flying sparks. Each word appears as if being welded to a metal surface, with the weld line traveling along the letter shapes. Include realistic welding effects: bright blue-white core with orange periphery, smoke wisps, and metal slag. Text should have a heat-affected zone with color gradients from blue (heated) through purple to normal metal. Add protective mask overlay effect that briefly darkens the screen during bright flashes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Complex effect system with multiple layers. Base: TextAtom with 'font-black text-transparent'. Weld line: SVG path animation following text outline using stroke-dasharray. Arc flash: radial-gradient div with filter: blur(20px) brightness(3), opacity pulses. Sparks: particle system with 30+ divs, 'bg-yellow-300 rounded-full', parabolic trajectories via @keyframes with transform: translate() rotate(). Heat zones: multiple text-shadow layers with different colors and blur radii. Smoke: semi-transparent divs with filter: blur() and transform animations. Mask effect: fullscreen overlay 'fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 pointer-events-none' with opacity animation. Use waveform effects for spark intensity if audio available. Timing: 2s per word, continuous welding motion, sparks throughout duration.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'hydraulic display panel' preset where text emerges from retractable metal panels, like industrial signage systems. Each word is on a separate panel that extends outward with hydraulic motion (slow start, acceleration, deceleration). Panels have worn metal textures with scratches, oil stains, and industrial warning labels. Include mechanical details: visible hydraulic pistons, pressure gauges animating during movement, and steam releases at full extension. Text should have stencil-style cutouts with slight light bleed around edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'flex flex-col gap-1' for panel stack. Each panel: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-700 via-gray-600 to-gray-700 shadow-lg'. Hydraulic motion: transform: translateX() with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1) for mechanical feel. Pistons: ::before elements 'absolute left-0 w-8 h-2 bg-gray-500' with width animation. Texture overlays: multiple background-image layers for scratches (linear-gradient), oil (radial-gradient). Stencil text: 'font-black uppercase' with text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.3) for light bleed. Warning labels: small divs with 'bg-yellow-400 text-black text-xs font-bold px-1'. Steam: opacity animation on blur filtered divs at extension point. Gauge rotation: transform: rotate() on gauge needle element. Timing: 1.8s per panel with 0.2s overlap, slow-in-fast-out easing.
